changelog: Reserve duties are now recognized in Today’s Duty, including variable day/night standby windows
Flight Details timeline reordered, Roster Published removed, Open MEL restyled, Pre-flight Checklist removed
Weather invalid ICAO handling now shows a short user-friendly message instead of raw API errors
Bottom navigation now uses Messages; Fleet moved to More and Alerts removed from More
Monthly Flight Time now shows Selected 80h/90h instead of the fixed 90h limit
Added GitHub Actions release workflow to build and publish APK releases automatically
